call_GlmAsrProcessor: call the GlmAsrProcessor to transcribe audio with text prompts and return tokenized inputs for the model
apply_GlmAsrProcessor_transcription_requ: apply a transcription request to audio files or arrays with optional custom prompts and return batch-ready model inputs
decode_GlmAsrProcessor_outputs: decode model output token IDs using the GlmAsrProcessor tokenizer with optional prefix stripping for transcription responses
build_GlmAsrProcessor_from_extractor_and: build a GlmAsrProcessor from a WhisperFeatureExtractor and Qwen2TokenizerFast with configurable audio token and max audio length
test_GlmAsrProcessor_batch_decode: test the GlmAsrProcessor batch_decode method to decode generated token sequences into readable transcription text
